caseNameFull: Master Time Co., Ltd. v. DeJongh, Commissioner of the Department of Finance of the Virgin Islands
attorneys: Warren H. Young for petitioner. Francisco Corneiro, Attorney General of the Virgin Islands, and Bruce MacGibbon, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
